map.为什么靠近时音调变高？: Why does pitch rise when it approaches?
map.声源朝听者运动时波前被压缩，到达频率升高；远离时波前拉伸，频率降低。: As the source moves toward the listener the wavefronts are compressed and the arrival frequency rises; when receding they stretch and the frequency drops.
map.听者运动与声源运动对称吗？: Are listener motion and source motion symmetric?
map.公式不对称：听者运动改分母（接收率），声源运动改分子（波间距），但极限结果相近。: The formula is asymmetric: listener motion changes the denominator (reception rate), source motion changes the numerator (wave spacing), though the limiting results are close.
